correctness.rationale: Same-edge electrical kernel R_ii=z-(l_i-rho)z^2/l_i^2 and distinct-edge R_ij=x(l_i-x)/l_i+y(l_j-y)/l_j+rho(x/l_i-y/l_j)^2 follow from removing an edge and the grounded Gaussian bridge/Kirchhoff network. Their exact ordered integrals are (l_i^3+rho*l_i^2)/6 and l_i*l_j*(l_i+l_j+rho)/6, yielding the displayed formula. Writing p_i=l_i/L and h=(sum 1/p_i)^-1, Cauchy gives sum p_i(1-p_i)^2 >= (m-1)^2 h, strict upper when m>=3 and cycle equality for m=2. For m=3, with u=pq+pr+qr<=1/3 and v=pqr>0, 6 ER/L=1-u+v(1/u-3)>=2/3, equality only p=q=r. Tested 400 independent nodal Kirchhoff injection systems against both kernels with different arm lengths. These finite tests corroborate rather than prove the all-parameter inequalities.
